observation.visible_scene: A steep hillside covered in dry grass is burning, with several orange flame patches and rising smoke along the slope. An elevated wooden platform or deck supported by posts and a concrete footing occupies the upper portion of the view, while a dark blurry object intrudes at the right edge. Hazy hills and sky are visible in the background.
visible_changes: The flames flicker and change shape continuously throughout the excerpt.
Smoke drifts upward and partially obscures the slope and the structure.
The framing changes during the clip: an initially close view of burning grass shifts to a wider view that reveals more of the elevated wooden structure and the hazy background.
The apparent positions of the flame patches within the frame change, most consistent with camera movement rather than large movement of the burning grass itself.
A flame patch visible on the left in the earliest frames is no longer prominent in later frames, while central and lower flame patches remain visible throughout.
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause of the fire and whether it is spreading, being controlled, or diminishing.
What happens to the fire after the excerpt ends.
Whether the left-side flame patch extinguished or simply moved out of the frame.
The exact identity and role of the dark object at the right edge.
uncertain_details: The precise camera motion, such as pan, tilt, or zoom, is not certain.
The identity of the overhead structure is not fully clear.
It is uncertain whether any apparent movement of the fire is due to actual fire progression or only changes in viewpoint.
